start.content: You walked up Mount Olivet. Most people approach Jerusalem and see only walls. He spoke in parables. People laughed, left, or argued. Then He asked the question.

question.content: He asked about the stone the builders rejected. The stone that becomes the cornerstone. The crowd was silent after that. Some looked confused. Some looked... afraid.

crowd_reaction.content: People laughed, then left, or argued. The parables were not comfortable. They were mirrors. Each person saw themselves — and didn't always like what they saw.

closing.content: He spoke as someone who owned the Law, not merely interpreted it. That was the most unsettling thing of all.
